rule: Used to tune card_promotion.py rules and the SCHEMA_PROMPT. Throw-away set; not the held-out suite. 2026-09-30: dev-52 relabelled card-worthy (the user asks for a table; the rules promote a requested table with >= 2 data rows). 2026-09-30 (after HELD-OUT v3 on the 2B): dev-53..57 added for the explanation-led topic-word and 'without using a list' classes. 2026-09-30 (after HELD-OUT v3 on the 9B): dev-58..dev-74 added for comparisons written as headed sections and for explanations with headed sections.
